Privacy Policy

What happens to your information in the Mass Reaction game and on this website. The short version: very little.

LAST UPDATED
9 November 2026
APPLIES TO
Mass Reaction for iPhone and massreaction.app

Who we are

Mass Reaction is an iPhone game made by Yulia Shishkina, an independent developer, who is responsible for the processing described in this policy (“we”, “us”). For any privacy question or request, .

In short

The game has no ads, no analytics, no tracking and no sign-up. It has no server of its own and does not send your data to us. The only services it talks to are Apple’s: the App Store for purchases, iCloud for your stash of special balls, and Game Center for the leaderboard. Each of them is run by Apple under Apple’s Privacy Policy.

On your device

The game keeps a few things on your iPhone: your best score, your settings (such as vibration), which special-ball tips you have already seen, and a copy of your stash. This information stays on the device, is not sent to us, and is removed when you delete the game.

Your stash in iCloud

If iCloud is turned on for the game, it keeps counters of the special balls you have bought and used in your private iCloud key-value storage, so your stash follows you to your other devices and survives reinstalling. To keep devices from overwriting each other, the game creates a random identifier for each device; it is not linked to your name, Apple ID or any advertising identifier.

This data is stored by Apple in your iCloud account. We cannot see or access it. If iCloud is off, the stash is kept only on that device and is lost if the game is deleted.

In-app purchases

Special-ball packs are optional and sold through Apple’s in-app purchase system. Apple handles the payment; we never receive your card details or billing address. The game receives a confirmation of the transaction from Apple so it can add the items to your stash.

Game Center

If you are signed in to Game Center, the game submits your score at the end of a run to the Mass Reaction leaderboard. Depending on your Game Center settings, your nickname and score can be visible to other players. Game Center is operated by Apple; you can manage your profile and visibility in your iPhone settings.

This website

massreaction.app has no cookies, analytics, advertising trackers, accounts, forms or browser storage. Fonts and images are served with the site rather than loaded from other services. The only script on the site builds our support address when you click a contact button; it stores nothing.

To deliver and protect the pages, our hosting provider in the European Union and Cloudflare, which sits in front of the site, process technical connection data such as your IP address, browser type, the page requested and the time. This data is used only to run and secure the site and is not combined with other information.

When you contact us

If you email us, we receive your email address, your message and anything you choose to include. We use it only to answer you. Mail to our support address is forwarded by Cloudflare Email Routing to a mailbox hosted by Google. We keep correspondence for as long as needed to handle your request and any follow-up, and then delete it. Please do not send card details, passwords or other sensitive information.

Legal bases

Where the EU or UK General Data Protection Regulation applies, we rely on: performing our contract with you, to deliver purchased items; our legitimate interest in operating and securing the website and in answering your messages; and your choices, such as turning on iCloud or signing in to Game Center.

Children

The game does not ask for or collect personal information on our side from anyone, including children. Purchases and Game Center are subject to the parental controls of the Apple account used on the device.

Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or erase your personal data, to receive a copy of it, and to restrict or object to its processing. To make a request, . Data held by Apple, including iCloud, purchases and Game Center, is managed through your Apple account.

You can also complain to your local data-protection authority. For the European Union, see the European Commission’s overview of your rights.

Changes

If the game starts handling information differently, for example by adding a new service, we will update this page and its date before the change reaches you.
